reference.description: Python gidi.inference GidiPredictor on the gidi-finance-v3 INT8 model (whole-word target snap, value from gidi.value_parser); ORT session at ORT_ENABLE_BASIC (graph as written). The default-level session is compared separately.

environment.wasm_flavour: ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm (CPU/WASM execution provider, SIMD build, no JSEP/WebGPU/WebNN)
environment.simd: always on in this build (no flag in 1.30)
environment.graph_optimization_level: all requested; logits are identical at disabled/basic/extended/layout/all in this wasm build (no fused DynamicQuantizeMatMul), i.e. the graph runs as written
environment.tokenizer_and_crf: TypeScript (src/runtime), same thread as the ORT session: Node main thread in this runner; dedicated Web Worker in the browser

vs_python_default_session.note: Informational. ORT's default level fuses DynamicQuantizeMatMul/MatMulIntegerToFloat; its arm64 native kernel (KleidiAI) quantizes activations differently from the ONNX graph semantics that onnxruntime-web executes.
